title: College Football

title: College Football
desc: The No. 2 Utes (9-0, 6-0 Big 12) seek their first 10-0 start since 2008 as they visit the No. 23 Wildcats (7-2, 4-2). Utah comes off a 28-20 triumph over rival BYU. Arizona has won seven straight at home following a 29-28 victory over TCU last week.

title: College Football
